color-system.twistDescription: No twist — copied verbatim. Color register: light (pageBackground #f0ece0, luminance 235.8). Warm cream/amber palette with golden yellow accent (#f4b30c), near-black body text (#1a1200), transparent nav that scrolls to cream.

type-system.twistDescription: Twist B: Letter spacing injection at intensity 3 (0.06em). Original weld-straw used -1.26px negative tracking on h1 — replaced with +0.06em positive tracking applied to all heading elements. Shifts from tight condensed compression to open lapidary spacing, complementing the amber palette's inscriptional register. Inter confirmed on Google Fonts CDN.

motion-system.twistDescription: Twist C: Easing curve swap at intensity 4. Replaced cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1) with cubic-bezier(0.68, -0.55, 0.265, 1.55) — a springy overshoot easing that gives all transitions a mechanical rebound character. Duration values preserved from weld-ivory's ×1.5 scaling (fast: 0.3s, base: 0.45s, slow: 0.75s). Result: languid timing with clockwork spring arrival.

grid-system.twistDescription: Twist C: Container padding asymmetric at intensity 4. paddingLeft reduced from 77px to 65px (−12px), paddingRight increased from 77px to 89px (+12px). Creates subtle rightward weight bias — reading column leans slightly off-center, introducing editorial tension without structural disruption.

spacing-system.twistDescription: Twist D: Button padding shift, wider, intensity 3. Button horizontal padding added at 20px L/R. CTA horizontal padding increased from 12px to 20px (+8px each side). Section breathing room (+32px) preserved from weld-ash source. Creates more expansive button targets complementing the open heading letter-spacing.

interaction-states.twistDescription: Twist A: Hover transition speed, more languid, intensity 3. All hover transition durations increased from 0.3s to 0.45s (+0.15s). Aligns interaction timing precisely with the motion system's base duration — a unified temporal register across all hover and layout transitions.

nav-system.twistDescription: Twist A: Nav height adjustment, slimmer, intensity 3. Height reduced from 50px to 40px (−10px). Nav becomes a typographic ribbon rather than a structural band. Uppercase Inter at 0.12em letter-spacing preserved, right-to-left underline animation at 0.45s synchronized with motion system.

concept-summary.twistDescription: Twist C: Material shift. Added one paragraph in the Content Sections section describing the physical-tactile quality of the 30px border-radius cards — comparing the radius to the corner of a well-worn index card or matte-laminated print piece, and the 60px card padding to gallery label whitespace. Generated full concept_by_video.md with 3 video placement recommendations (hero-bg.mp4, cta-ambient.mp4, mission-surface.mp4).
